title: tunnel_authorization.json drifted from its generator (--check reports out-of-date)
description: Pre-existing failure found while working sz1s (unrelated; reproduces with the sz1s diff reverted): python tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py::test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh runs test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py --check which reports 'out-of-date vector file: tunnel_authorization.json'. Someone changed the generator or the JSON without regenerating; the committed vector file no longer matches what the generator produces. Investigate which side moved (git log on both), regenerate or revert as appropriate, and note whether the wrong_algorithm negative case (authorizations[9], protected_hex a10139ffff) is preserved. Also re-check test_authorization_intermediates_use_independent_oracle which asserts the VALID case uses a1013a00010000.
